scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ludo/web" "npm run dev -w @ludo/server" "npm run dev -w @ludo/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ludo/web && npm run build -w @ludo/admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,server,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w @ludo/web" "npm run start -w @ludo/server" "npm run start -w @ludo/admin"
